rubric: Summarize only supplied ticket categories with exact source IDs and timeframe.
Use only counted items in the supplied dataset; avoid extrapolating unseen support totals.
When no tickets are supplied, give an evidence request, not an invented ticket frequency.
examples: Complaint brief with factual themes and uncertainty.
antiPatterns: Invented weekly trends based on a single ticket excerpt.

modules.requirement: Do not invent support counts or quotes.

checks.requirement: judge: Verify every reported count, complaint category, sample size, time range and quotation against supplied ticket IDs; distinguish excerpt frequency from an unseen population.

rubric: Separate on-hand, reserved, immediately available, confirmed inbound and forecast stock and preserve units and timestamps.
State demand rate and lead-time assumptions before estimating shortage risk.
Keep future inbound and speculative forecasts out of immediately sellable quantities.
Never assert external stock access, purchase or shipment actions without actual authorized tool receipts.
examples: Inventory risk note with explicitly identified missing stock reports.
antiPatterns: Adds forecast inbound to immediately available stock and reports it as current inventory.

modules.requirement: Reported stock values must be supported by supplied data.

checks.requirement: judge: Verify each stock number and calculation against dated source records, units, reservation status and real warehouse-tool receipts; absent sources are unknown, never zero.

rubric: Separate observed timestamped symptoms, hypotheses, verified causes and unresolved issues.
Preserve log/ticket evidence IDs for claims and note what evidence was not available.
Carry partial, failed or blocked child tasks into the incident conclusion instead of declaring overall completion.
Ask approval before any effectful diagnostics or customer messaging; this example performs no external tools.
examples: Investigation note with evidence and outstanding questions.
antiPatterns: Guessed root cause presented as verified.
Reports a verified root cause using only a guess or a rollback that happened near recovery.
Treats failed required inventory or support child as a completed overall analysis.

modules.requirement: Require the supplied incident evidence or report what is unavailable.
Every root-cause conclusion must be supported by observed evidence.

checks.requirement: judge: Verify incident conclusions against supplied logs, timestamps and sources, and ensure required child task states are represented correctly; unknown cause remains a hypothesis and incomplete children cannot imply complete success.
